subject_uz: Neft tashuvchi avtosisternalarda (30 m3 va undan yuqori) neft tashish xizmati, tonna-kilometr hisobida

requirements.summary_uz: 70 balldan kam toʻplagan texnik taklif qabul qilinmaydi.
requirements.summary_en: A technical offer scoring below 70 points is rejected.
requirements.quote: Ballarning maksimal miqdori - 100. 70 balldan kam to'plagan texnik taklif qabul qilinmaydi.

requirements.summary_uz: Barcha transport vositalarini GPS bilan jihozlash va monitoring tizimiga kirish haqida kafolat xati uchun 25 ball beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: A guarantee letter to fit all vehicles with GPS and give login access to the monitoring system earns 25 points.
requirements.quote: Shartnoma tuzilganda barcha transport vositalarini GPS bilan jihozlash hamda monitoring tizimiga kirish uchun login va parol taqdim etilishi haqida kafolat xati berilgan

requirements.summary_uz: Texnikani quyish punktlariga 10 kalendar kungacha yetkazib berish kafolati uchun 10 ball beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: A guarantee to deliver the vehicles to the loading points within 10 calendar days earns 10 points.
requirements.quote: Buyurtmachining quyish punktlariga texnikani 10 kalendar kungacha yetkazib berishni tasdiqlovchi kafolat xati — 10 ball.

requirements.summary_uz: 2020-yil va undan keyin ishlab chiqarilgan texnika roʻyxati 15 ball, 2010-yildan keyingisi 10 ball beradi.
requirements.summary_en: A list of vehicles built in 2020 or later earns 15 points; 2010 or later earns 10.
requirements.quote: Texnikaning sozligi va foydalanishga tayyorligini tasdiqlovchi kafolat xati hamda 2020-yil va undan keyin ishlab chiqarilgan texnikalar ro‘yxati — 15 ball.

requirements.summary_uz: Barcha haydovchilarda xavfli yuklarni tashishga ruxsat hujjatlari boʻlishi kerak (25 ball).
requirements.summary_en: All drivers must hold dangerous-goods transport permits (25 points).
requirements.quote: Barcha haydovchilarning xavfli yuklarni tashishga ruxsat hujjatlari bilan ta’minlanganligi

requirements.summary_uz: Neft va neft mahsulotlarini tashishda 3 yil va undan ortiq tajriba shartnomalar nusxalari bilan tasdiqlanadi (15 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Three or more years of oil-transport experience, confirmed by contract copies, earns 15 points.
requirements.quote: Neft va neft mahsulotlarini tashish bo‘yicha 3 yil va undan ortiq tajribani tasdiqlovchi shartnomalar nusxalari

requirements.summary_uz: Taʼsis hujjatlari va davlat roʻyxatidan oʻtganlik haqidagi guvohnoma talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Constituent documents and the state registration certificate are required.
requirements.quote: Таъсис хужжатлари ва фаолиятининг қонуний асослари ҳамда давлат рўйхатидан ўтказилганлиги тўғрисидаги гувоҳнома мавжудлиги.

requirements.summary_uz: Safarbarlik muddati shartnoma tuzilgan kundan boshlab texnikani quyish punktlariga yetkazib berish bilan oʻlchanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Mobilisation time is measured from contract signing to delivery of vehicles to the loading points.
requirements.quote: Safarbarlik muddati — shartnoma tuzilgan kundan boshlab texnikani quyish punktlariga yetkazib berish

requirements.summary_uz: Tijorat taklifi taqdim etilgan sanadan boshlab kamida 90 kalendar kun amal qilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The commercial offer must remain valid for at least 90 calendar days.

reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni cheklovchi jiddiy shart topilmadi.
reasons_en: No seriously restrictive condition was found in the document.
